correctness.rationale: For every positive orthogonal box, the random half-perimeter of its orthogonal planar shadow is sum a_i sqrt(1-U_i^2). Symmetric spherical moments give m1=(pi/4)p1, m2=alpha p1^2+(2/3-alpha)p2, m3=beta p1^3+3(5pi/32-beta)p1p2+(2beta-9pi/32)p3. Since E(X1-X2)^2>0, alpha<2/3; Cauchy–Schwarz plus E product(1-U_i^2)=4/21 gives 2beta<=4/sqrt21<9pi/32. Thus invert all three p_k and Newton cubic to recover unordered positive sides, including multiplicities. An explicit distinct pair of shapes with same p1,p2 and a local circle establish sharpness. Independent sphere integration yielded alpha≈0.59321360684 beta≈0.42181219067, negative third coefficient ≈−0.03994855, and cross-checked near-exact inversion; quadrature error is not proof.
